name: Top 20 S&P 500 Sell-Offs - Technical Analysis
description: Identify the 20 S&P 500 stocks with the largest 1-week decline and analyze their technical positioning relative to key benchmarks (50-day MA, 52-week high, all-time high).
source:
# =============================================================================
# TOP 20 S&P 500 SELL-OFFS - TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
# Identify worst weekly performers and analyze technical positioning
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# 1-WEEK PERFORMANCE
# =============================================================================

# 5-day rate of change (1 week of trading days)
week_return = roc(period=5)(close)
week_return_pct = week_return * 100

# =============================================================================
# 50-DAY MOVING AVERAGE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

ma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Calculate percentage distance from MA
# Positive = above MA, Negative = below MA
pct_from_ma_50 = (close - ma_50) / ma_50 * 100

# Boolean for whether trading below MA
below_ma_50 = close < ma_50

# =============================================================================
# 52-WEEK HIGH ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# 252 trading days = 1 year
high_52w = max(period=252)(close)

# Detect when price is at 52-week high (within 0.01% tolerance)
tolerance = 0.0001
is_at_52w_high = close >= high_52w * (1 - tolerance)

# Count days since last 52-week high
days_since_52w_high = barssince()(is_at_52w_high)

# =============================================================================
# ALL-TIME HIGH ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# Expanding max gives all-time high
high_ath = max(period=999999)(close)

# Detect when price is at all-time high (within 0.01% tolerance)
is_at_ath = close >= high_ath * (1 - tolerance)

# Count days since all-time high
days_since_ath = barssince()(is_at_ath)

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL AGGREGATION FOR CARDS
# =============================================================================

# Convert boolean to numeric for percentage calculation
below_ma_numeric = 1 if below_ma_50 else 0

# =============================================================================
# VISUALIZATIONS - SUMMARY CARDS
# =============================================================================

cs_cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Key Metrics",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title="Worst Performer",
                card_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_color=Color.Error
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title="Average Decline",
                card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_color=Color.Warning
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title="% Below 50-Day MA",
                card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                card_slot=CardSlot.SecondaryBadge,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=0,
                card_color=Color.Info
            )
        ]
    ),
    category="1. Overview",
    agg=AggregationType.Last
)(week_return_pct, week_return_pct, below_ma_numeric)

# =============================================================================
# DETAILED TABLE - TOP 20 SELL-OFFS
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title="Top 20 S&P 500 Sell-Offs - Technical Position",
    category="2. Analysis",
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[
        AssetFilter(rank=AssetFilterRank.Bottom, count=20, column=0)
    ]),
    max_assets=20,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title="1-Week Return %",
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                grid_color=Color.Error
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title="% vs 50-Day MA",
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                grid_color_map={Color.Green: ["POSITIVE"], Color.Red: ["NEGATIVE"]}
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title="Days Since 52-Wk High",
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title="Days Since All-Time High",
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat
            )
        ]
    )
)(week_return_pct, pct_from_ma_50, days_since_52w_high, days_since_ath)

# =============================================================================
# BAR CHART - WEEKLY RETURNS DISTRIBUTION
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title="1-Week Returns Distribution",
    category="2. Analysis",
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[
        AssetFilter(rank=AssetFilterRank.Bottom, count=20, column=0)
    ]),
    max_assets=20
)(week_return_pct)
